data.narrative:
Runpod is a Series C frontier-tech company in Chips & Semiconductors, having raised $122.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-market transactions in the same sector and stage cohort, including Tenstorrent ($2.7B, Series D), Positron AI ($1.0B, Series B), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C).

Two valuation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base, applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $208M. Peer-median triangulation across the 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables produces a $1.0B midpoint, with a range spanning $529M to $2.7B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (median 18.4x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of revenue disclosure for the target.

Synthesizing the two applicable methods produces a triangulated range of $177M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $604M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around where Runpod sits relative to peer maturity, market traction, and capital efficiency. Stage-progression implies conservative end; peer medians suggest higher valuation plausible. Resolution hinges on revenue scale, unit economics, and competitive positioning within the semiconductor infrastructure segment.
